weekend_note: A cold snap arrives: Friday high 64, Saturday only 58, Sunday 62, with lows from 42 to 50 and dry skies all weekend (a 20% rain chance shows up Monday). Picks: Festa Italiana (Fri-Sat), the Fall Food Truck Fest and Launch's grand opening (Sat), then EggFest and SEC soccer championship day (Sun), all outdoors except Launch, so bundle up. White Tie Rock at the ballpark Friday night and the Ice Flyers at the Bay Center are fallback evening options.

news.title: SS United States sunk off Okaloosa County to become world's largest artificial reef
news.summary: The former ocean liner was set for a 1 PM Veterans Day sinking in the Gulf off Okaloosa County; officials hope the reef draws divers and tourists. Follow-up outlets report it went down.

news.title: Pensacola begins budget cuts across all 18 departments
news.summary: After Amendment 3 passed, the mayor projects $4.2 million less property tax revenue next year, growing to a $7.2 million shortfall by October 2028.

news.title: Baptist Hospital plans 40 new acute-care beds
news.summary: The beds go in the Henderson building at the main campus; the hospital may hire 80 or more nurses, with open interviews in November and December.

news.title: Panhandle Ice Pier taking shape in Pace
news.summary: A privately funded year-round rink with skate rentals is under construction and expected to open by summer 2027.

news.title: FPL flags some Pensacola neighborhoods for underground power lines
news.summary: Residents are getting flyers about the Storm Secure Underground Program; outreach is early and design plus construction takes about two years.

news.title: UWF police make arrest in online bomb threat case
news.summary: Campus police arrested an individual after finishing their investigation into a recent online threat.

news.title: Blue Angels Elementary honors veterans with hallway salute
news.summary: The Pensacola school held a salute the day before Veterans Day.

coverage_note: Updated Thursday, Nov 12. Forecast from WeatherBug's 9-day page; it lists rain chance only for Mon Nov 16 (20%), so other days show 0 as unstated. Events come from Must Do's Nov 9-15 guide and November guide plus carried-over listings; the SS United States entry was dropped after its Nov 11 sinking. News comes from WEAR and FOX10. NorthEscambia.com pages mostly would not load and its home page showed no Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah or Cantonment events, so north Escambia coverage is thin. Restaurant statuses were mostly carried over; only Launch was updated. Items marked 'See event page' had no times on the sources I read.
